Dunn & Acosta LLP
Conroe, TX
Phone 713-555-4341
Settlement Demand
26 Nov 2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1473 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our firm represents Billy Jones in connection with the motor vehicle collision that
occurred on 8 Apr 2023 at a signalized intersection. Our client was proceeding through
the intersection on a green light when your insured failed to yield and struck the
driver's side of our client's vehicle. The impact was severe enough to deploy airbags
and leave both vehicles with extensive structural damage, as documented in the
enclosed police report and repair estimates.
As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a significant injury to the
right shoulder, including a torn rotator cuff that has required diagnostic imaging,
orthopedic consultation, and physical therapy. Our client has been unable to perform
overhead work and has missed substantial time from employment. Treatment is ongoing,
and the treating physiican has not yet released our cleint to full duty.
Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured admitted at the scene that he did not
see the signal before entering the intersection, and the independent witness statement
supports our client's account. There is no reasonable basis on which a jury would
assign fault to our client.
Accordingly, we demand payment of $64,000.00 to resolve all claims arising from this
incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If
we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without
further notice.
Expert review: Jennifer Miles, accident reconstructionist
Sincerely,
Candice Smith
Dunn & Acosta LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
